extraction_notes: Identity verified from the supplied PDF: the title is 2SC3356, the device is identified as a bipolar transistor (NPN), and the package drawing is SOT-23. The requested manufacturer identity is Guangdong Hottech; the PDF footer names SHENZHEN HOTTECH ELECTRONICS CO., LTD.
The PDF has four pages and no stated revision. Electrical characteristics are specified at TA = 25 degC unless otherwise specified.

The hFE table gives 50 minimum, 120 typical, and 300 maximum at VCE = 10 V and IC = 20 mA. The separate classification table gives rank ranges Q = 50-100, R = 80-160, S = 125-250, and T = 200-330; no rank was inferred.

The Cob table gives 0.55 pF typical and 1.0 pF maximum at VCB = 10 V, IE = 0, and f = 1 MHz. The scalar cobo field records the maximum value with source_kind maximum; the typical value is preserved here rather than relabelled.
Cibo is not tabulated in the supplied PDF. No VCE(sat), VBE(sat), or output-characteristics data are published, so saturation points are empty and Early voltage cannot be extracted.

The p. 2 typical-characteristics plots for hFE, fT, and feed-back capacitance were manually digitized at visible axis positions. Curve values are direct plot read-offs in SI units; no interpolation was used. The fT plot states VCE = 10 V, and the feed-back capacitance plot states f = 1.0 MHz.

Maximum ratings on p. 1 include VCBO = 20 V, VCEO = 12 V, VEBO = 3 V, IC = 100 mA, and PC = 200 mW at TA = 25 degC; these are not substituted for electrical-characteristic values except for the matching V(BR)CEO entry in vceo.
